143
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, April 5, 2018/Chaitra 15, 1940 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Prime Minister; Atomic Energy; Development of North Eastern
Region; External Affairs; Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises; Housing
and Urban Affairs; Human Resource Development; Personnel, Public
Grievances and Pensions; Planning; Social Justice and
Empowerment; Space; Statistics and Programme
Implementation; Tribal Affairs; Women and
Child Development)
Total number of questions — 15
Addressing urban migration
*406. SHRI K.C. RAMAMURTHY:
Will the Minister of HOUSING AND
URBAN AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the major schemes of the Ministry
aimed at addressing ever growing urban
migration in the country;
(b) the allocations made to address the
migration problem and the funds spent/
unspent during the last three years, year-
wise, State-wise and scheme-wise;
(c) the reasons for unspent allocations
during the above period; and
(d) the action initiated against those
who failed to spent the allocations during
this period?
Schemes for urban development
†*407. SHRI MAHESH PODDAR:
Will the Minister of HOUSING AND
URBAN AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the details of urban development
schemes under which Government has
allocated funds to various States,
particularly Jharkhand together with the
details of funds allocated thereunder during
the last three years;
(b) the details of the schemes which are
fully and partially funded by Government,
separately; and
(c) the details of role played by the
Central Government, State Governments
and local bodies in selection of such
schemes and finalising expenditure to be
incurred thereon?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

144
Cooperation in Rooppur Nuclear
Power Plant in Bangladesh
*408. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of PRIME MINISTER
be pleased to state:
(a) whether India, Russia and
Bangladesh have signed a Memorandum of
Understanding for cooperation in building
Rooppur Nuclear Power project in
Bangladesh;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) what would be the role of India and
that of Russian company in this project;
and
(d) the details of arrangements made for
supplying the fuel for running the plant?
Per capita income in States
†*409. SHRI PRABHAT JHA: Will the
Minister of PLANNING be pleased to
state:
(a) the names of States whose per
capita income has increased and of  those
whose per capita income has decreased
during the last one decade;
(b) the names of States whose annual
economic growth has improved and of those
whose growth has declined during that
period; and
(c) the names of States where the
highest number of cases of financial
irregularities have come to light and where
such cases have decreased during the period?
Recognition of Hindi and Bangla as
official languages in UN
*410. SHRI RITABRATA BANERJEE:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
is trying to get Hindi recognised as an
official language of the United Nations
(UN);
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government is also trying
to get Bangla and the other official languages
of  India recognised as the official languages
of the UN;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Urban and infrastructure
development schemes
*411. SHRI SANJAY SETH: Will the
Minister of HOUSING AND URBAN
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is running
urban and infrastructure development
schemes in small and medium towns;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the details of proposals received by
Government during the last three years and
the current year, so far, under these
schemes, city and State-wise;
(d) the details of proposals cleared and
funds sanctioned for these schemes; and
(e) the details of proposals pending, city
and State-wise and by when such proposals
are likely to be cleared?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

145
Establishment of Central Institutions
in Andhra Pradesh
*412. SHRI T.G . VENKATESH: Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has taken up
the process of establishment of Central
Institutions in Andhra Pradesh as per the
provisions of Andhra Pradesh Re-
organisation Act, 2014;
(b) if so, the details, and the number of
institutions established, so far and those
yet to be established along with the funds
allocated and released to each such
institution;
(c) the present status of operations of
these institutions and the reasons for delay
in establishing other such institutions; and
(d) the steps being taken by
Government for their early establishment?
Allocation of funds for Assam
*413. SHRI BHUBANESWAR
KALITA: Will the Minister of
PLANNING be pleased to state:
(a) whether State Government of  Assam
has requested for enhanced allocation of
funds for education, health, rural
development, drinking

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, April 5, 2018/Chaitra 15, 1940 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Prime Minister; Atomic Energy; Development of North Eastern
Region; External Affairs; Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises;
Housing and Urban Affairs; Human Resource Development;
Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions;  Planning;
Social Justice and Empowerment; Space; Statistics
and Programme Implementation; Tribal Affairs;
Women and Child Development)
Total number of questions — 160
Launching of separate fund
by INIP
4321. SHRI K.C. RAMAMURTHY:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the Indian Nuclear
Insurance Pool (INIP) has launched a
separate fund to cover the  risks of nuclear
equipment suppliers under the Civil
Liability for Nuclear Damage Act, 2010;
and
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
funds sanctioned for this project?
Self-sufficiency in production of
Uranium
4322. SHRI MAHESH PODDAR: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) what steps Government is taking to
achieve self sufficiency in production of
Uranium;
(b) whether any time-line has been fixed
to execute projects for this purpose; and
(c) if so, the details of such projects and
their current status country-wide especially
in Jharkhand?
Setting-up of Mega Nuclear Power
Reactors
4323. SHRI SAMBHAJI
CHHATRAPATI: Will the PRIME
MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has taken a
decision to set-up ten Mega Power
Pressurised Heavy Water Reactors with a
total capacity of 7,000 MW in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
locations identified for the purpose;
(c) whether any understanding has been
reached between India and France in respect
of nuclear reactor proposed to come up in
Rajasthan when the President of France
visited India recently; and

1016
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Complaint against flouting of
environmental rules
4324. SHRIMATI SASIKALA
PUSHPA: Will the PRIME MINISTER
be pleased to state:
(a) the details of ports in the country
through which Uranium is imported from
Russia, Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, France
and Canada;
(b) whether any rules and procedures
particularly with reference to environment
protection/conservation has been
prescribed by the International Atomic
Energy Agency (IAEA) for importing
Uranium;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether any complaint has been
lodged with IAEA against India in
connection with flouting of environmental
rules/norms while importing Uranium; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Agreement between NPCIL and EDF
of France
4325. SHRI N. GOKULA-
KRISHNAN: Will the PRIME MINISTER
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Nuclear
Power Corporation of India Limited
(NPCIL) and EDF of France have signed
an agreement for building 10,000 MW
Jaitapur nuclear power plant, making India
the fifth country to opt for the European
Pressurised Reactor (EPR) technology that
is yet to become commercially operational
anywhere in the world;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that all the
nuclear power projects using the EPR
technology currently under construction
are facing time and cost overruns; and
(d) if so, the details thereof'?
Special forum for inclusive growth in
NER
4326. SHRIMATI SAROJINI
HEMBRAM: Will the Minister of
DEVELOPMENT OF NORTH
EASTERN REGION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has created a
special forum to boost inclusive growth in
the North-Eastern Region (NER) of our
country;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether Government is planning for
more such initiatives to identify various
constraints in the way of sustainable growth
in this region?
Development of road network in NER
4327. SHRI SAMBHAJI
CHHATRAPATI: Will the Minister of
DEVELOPMENT OF NORTH
EASTERN REGION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has prepared
a comprehensive plan for developing road
network connecting major towns and cities
of North Eastern Region (NER);
(b) if so, the details thereof including
the status of progress in respect of arterial
road network in the region;
(c) whether any time-line has been fixed
for completion of the works planned; and
(d) if so, the details in respect of each
one of them?

1017
Facilitation of Arab diplomats at
Sapru House
4328. SHRIMATI W ANSUK SYIEM:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government facilitated a
gathering of Arab diplomats at Sapru
House, New Delhi housing its think-tank,
Indian Council of World Affairs (ICW A) to
observe the UN mandated International
Day of Solidarity (November 29) with the
Palestinian people;
(b) whether this symbolic gesture was
re-enacted when the Indian Prime Minister
recently flew into the Palestinian capital
Ramallah; and
(c) whether India was the first non-Arab
country to grant full diplomatic status to
the Palestine Liberation Organization
(PLO) representatives in New Delhi?
